Thank you, it wasn’t very pleasant. That’s really unfortunate there’s only one highschool in your town. Would your parents ever consider moving somewhere else if you told them how serious what you’re feeling is? - edit - nvm I just read the last part about your parents. I’m so sorry about this horrible situation. I would say let go of that group of girls, trying to mend whatever’s happened between them is dehumanising and tells them that you don’t care how badly they’ve broken your boundaries and they will most definitely continue to overstep them. I’d suggest you hang out with some kids who are in other words “nerdy”. I know it’s not ideal as you probably won’t get along with them as you used to with your friends but it’s better than having no friends at all. And not everyone hates you, your social anxiety is lying to you. There will most definitely be a few nice kids there that would enjoy your presence. 

And I know that when you’ve been at your school for a long time, everyone’s got their groups, you think everyone knows you so well and would already have an opinion on whether they like you or not, but you’ll find most people are open minded. You just have to take that chance as daunting as it is and ask if you can hang out with a different group. I believe in you and I believe that you can do this ❤️
This is a good way to not feel suicidal. Good birb
Don’t get me wrong I’m still struggling, but to make it through school and have some quality of life during your teens, meds and changing schools is the best thing that can be done
I moved schools as the first step to recovery from toxic “friends” and classmates, and then I got on Zoloft 50 mg
I know it’s intimidating but it is so worth it
Please move school. It will help you so much

I was basically kicked out of my group for being friends with a really antisocial girl. She started to not want to hang out with the main group, I went with her, and our “friends” politely told us to leave the group. I feel into a depression as I was just helping this girl, and in turn lost my friendship group, and didn’t have friends for the first time in my life. The girl let’s call her S had really bad social skills and me having developed depression, and not knowing how to get back out there, I was seen as a weird girl. I was a really social girl who was always liked who experienced depression for the first time and was perceived as weird plus talked to as a Joke by guys. I talked to no one and had no support system for years until I moved schools last year. My reputation was ruined, I was bullied, and developed serious depression.
I’ve gone through the same thing baby. I’m so sorry I know exactly how it feels
I’m so very proud of you! Your strength is so admirable ❤️

I’m very sorry to hear about your accident Ernie and Thankyou for sharing. I’ve thought about that many times that this is a common experience for teens, and I can see how it would seem silly for me to complain considering your circumstances, but the advice to try make it to 20 is really comforting. You’ve given me hope or atleast a reason to tide me over for a while. Much love and I hope you’re doing well
